entries.subject: Thomas et al. and PCK00011 Pallene ellipsoid
entries.finding: The published/PCK semiaxes 2.88 by 2.08 by 1.80 km define the selected analytic shape and supersede the earlier LPSC short-axis value.

entries.subject: Cassini N1496910582 low-phase patch
entries.finding: The 2005 clear-filter image provides a coarse 8 by 12 pixel brightness patch. Its limb fit supports pointing only, not feature-registered photography.

entries.subject: Cassini N1665947247 saturated 2010 trial
entries.finding: The raw saturation plateau leaves zero valid samples when paired-raw masking, the one-pixel inset and unchanged geometry limits are applied.
entries.revisitWhen: An unsaturated source product or independently justified saturated-pixel treatment can be evaluated.

entries.subject: Cassini N1694657087 high-phase 2011 trial
entries.finding: The 158-degree phase leaves only a thin uncertain illuminated rim, despite finer nominal resolution.
entries.revisitWhen: A lower-phase resolved view with usable interior can add coverage.

entries.subject: Cassini N1694661188 narrow-strip 2011 trial
entries.finding: The trial leaves only four interpolation footprints; the required margin leaves zero samples and limits were not relaxed.
entries.revisitWhen: A view with broad qualified interior or independently reduced pointing uncertainty can be assessed.

entries.subject: Pallene feature-registration follow-up
entries.finding: The direct 2026-09-10 review found no independently identifiable feature in the 8 by 13 pixel disc. Existing limb fit remains pointing evidence.
entries.revisitWhen: Independent surface controls or an image with stable identifiable features can qualify feature registration.

entries.subject: Other finer 2010 and 2011 Pallene ISS frames
entries.finding: The OPUS survey records 39 Pallene-targeted observations at 2 km per pixel or finer. Apart from the separately recorded saturated, high-phase and narrow-strip trials, the remaining 2010/2011 frames have phase, saturation or coverage limits that do not establish a useful qualified addition to the selected 2005 patch.
entries.revisitWhen: A distinct frame with broad unsaturated, low- or moderate-phase interior and independently supportable registration can be assessed.

entries.subject: PDS eleven-body Saturn satellite shape inventory
entries.finding: The reviewed PDS satellite-shape inventory does not include Pallene, so it cannot supply a detailed Pallene mesh or local elevation field for this package.
entries.revisitWhen: A PDS or other released Pallene-specific shape product with a documented frame and provenance can be reviewed.

entries.subject: Thomas and Helfenstein 2020 updated shape survey
entries.finding: The updated shape survey was inspected as a route, but the full text was unavailable at review time. It therefore does not establish a new Pallene mesh or elevation source; the current PCK and 2013 published semiaxes remain selected.
entries.revisitWhen: Accessible full text or a linked Pallene-specific released model can be assessed against the selected semiaxes.

entries.subject: Hedman et al. Pallene integrated photometry
entries.finding: The reviewed photometry supplies integrated brightness context only. It does not provide a registered colour, composition or terrain map.
entries.revisitWhen: A spatially resolved and registered Pallene colour, spectral or composition product can support a lens.
